title: Data Lake Pipeline
description: Details of a Data Lake Pipeline.

_id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the Data Lake Pipeline.

createdDate.description: Timestamp that indicates when the Data Lake Pipeline was created. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

groupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the group.

lastUpdatedDate.description: Timestamp that indicates the last time that the Data Lake Pipeline was updated. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

name.description: Name of this Data Lake Pipeline.

state.description: State of this Data Lake Pipeline.

transformations.description: Fields to be excluded for this Data Lake Pipeline.

DatasetRetentionPolicy.description: Dataset Retention Policy for a Scheduled Data Lake Pipeline.

lastModifiedDate.description: Date when retention policy was last modified. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

units.description: Quantity of time in which the Data Lake Pipeline measures dataset retention.

value.description: Number that indicates the amount of days, weeks, or months that the Data Lake Pipeline will retain datasets.

DatasetRetentionPolicy.title: Dataset Retention Policy

FieldTransformation.description: Field Transformations during ingestion of a Data Lake Pipeline.

type.description: Type of transformation applied during the export of the namespace in a Data Lake Pipeline.

FieldTransformation.title: Field Transformation

IngestionSink.description: Ingestion destination of a Data Lake Pipeline.

type.description: Type of ingestion destination of this Data Lake Pipeline.

IngestionSink.title: Ingestion Destination

IngestionSource.description: Ingestion Source of a Data Lake Pipeline.

type.description: Type of ingestion source of this Data Lake Pipeline.

IngestionSource.title: Ingestion Source
